name: Sand in Taufers (Italy)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sand in Taufers (red and white bars with blue lozenges).
history: Municipal flag of Sand in Taufers, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sand in Taufers arms — red and white bars charged with blue lozenges
